lastRequest: Build a gorgeous dark-themed space exploration dashboard using HTML and CSS, featuring star maps, active space missions, spacecraft telemetries, celestial weather indices, interactive orbital calculators, responsive designs, modern Outfit fonts, custom glowing card components, smooth animations, and clean layouts

tasks.title: Project Setup and Core Types
tasks.description: Initialize TypeScript React project with Tailwind CSS, configure routing, state management stores, and core TypeScript interfaces for space entities, missions, and telemetry data.

tasks.title: Data Layer and API Simulation Services
tasks.description: Implement robust data services and repository patterns using local storage and mock real-time WebSocket feeds for celestial bodies, active spacecraft, live telemetry, and upcoming launches.

tasks.title: Dashboard UI Components and Layout
tasks.description: Develop responsive layout skeleton, navigation sidebar, metrics widgets, and reusable UI components adhering to clean architecture and Tailwind design systems.

tasks.title: Interactive Views and Mission Control Modules
tasks.description: Build interactive views including orbital tracker, mission control logs, celestial map, and real-time telemetry charts with full error handling and loading states.

tasks.title: Testing, Validation, and Performance Optimization
tasks.description: Perform comprehensive unit and integration testing, optimize bundle size, ensure strict accessibility compliance, and finalize production readiness.
